subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should backup exclude support require explicit ignore-file opt-in and full per-asset filtering before merge, or may it ship with implicit `.backupignore` loading plus warning-only external-asset bypass semantics?
rationale: The remaining blockers decide what backup coverage guarantees OpenClaw should make for sensitive and external assets, which is a product/security boundary rather than a purely mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Require explicit and complete semantics
options.body: Make `.backupignore` opt-in or explicitly approved, apply excludes to every planned backup asset with per-asset bases or fail unsupported combinations, and keep archive verification bounded before merge.

options.title: Accept limited semantics
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally ship implicit `.backupignore` loading and warning-only external-asset bypasses, but should document that some requested excludes do not affect all backup sources.

options.title: Restart narrower
options.body: Pause or close this branch and ask for a smaller PR that first lands exclude flags without the implicit file/default and full-rescan semantics.

recommendation.title: Require explicit and complete semantics
recommendation.body: Make `.backupignore` opt-in or explicitly approved, apply excludes to every planned backup asset with per-asset bases or fail unsupported combinations, and keep archive verification bounded before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup hardening work makes vincentkoc the strongest routing candidate for the backup coverage and upgrade-safety decision.
